sections.title: Describing a stretch of time
sections.content: You met *-tól/-től ... -ig* in A1 (*reggeltől estig*, *nyolctól ötig*); here it describes a working day. Pair *-tól/-től* ("from") with *-ig* ("until") to describe a span of time. Unlike most Hungarian suffixes, *-ig* doesn't harmonize at all: it's always *-ig*.

items.english: I work from nine to five.

sections.content: You can drop the second *óra* just like with *-kor* — *kilenctől ötig*, not *kilenc órától öt óráig*, is the natural everyday way to say it.
